findings.title: [DASHBOARD] Missing security header: Content Security Policy (CSP)
findings.detail: CSP instructs the browser which content sources are trusted. Without it, any injected script — from a compromised ad, third-party CDN, or XSS payload — runs freely in your customers' browsers.
findings.evidence: [Page: dashboard] Header "content-security-policy" absent from HTTP response of https://integrity-dashboard-bf73ab673f4c.herokuapp.com/login
findings.recommendation: Add a Content-Security-Policy header. Start with: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' and expand only as needed.

findings.title: [DASHBOARD] Missing security header: HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS)
findings.detail: HSTS forces browsers to always use HTTPS for future visits. Without it, a first-time visitor can be targeted with an SSL-stripping attack that silently downgrades their connection to HTTP.
findings.evidence: [Page: dashboard] Header "strict-transport-security" absent from HTTP response of https://integrity-dashboard-bf73ab673f4c.herokuapp.com/login

findings.title: [DASHBOARD] Missing security header: X-Frame-Options
findings.detail: Prevents the site from being embedded in iframes on other domains, blocking clickjacking attacks where an attacker tricks users into clicking hidden UI elements.
findings.evidence: [Page: dashboard] Header "x-frame-options" absent from HTTP response of https://integrity-dashboard-bf73ab673f4c.herokuapp.com/login
findings.recommendation: Add: X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN  (or use CSP frame-ancestors 'self')

findings.title: [DASHBOARD] Missing security header: X-Content-Type-Options
findings.detail: Prevents MIME-type sniffing. Without it, browsers may interpret files as a different type than declared (e.g., running a text file as JavaScript).
findings.evidence: [Page: dashboard] Header "x-content-type-options" absent from HTTP response of https://integrity-dashboard-bf73ab673f4c.herokuapp.com/login

findings.title: [DASHBOARD] Missing security header: Referrer-Policy
findings.detail: Controls how much referrer information is sent when a user navigates away. Without it, full URLs (including order IDs or search terms) may leak to third-party analytics.
findings.evidence: [Page: dashboard] Header "referrer-policy" absent from HTTP response of https://integrity-dashboard-bf73ab673f4c.herokuapp.com/login

findings.title: [DASHBOARD] Missing security header: Permissions-Policy
findings.detail: Restricts which browser APIs (camera, microphone, geolocation) scripts on the page can access. Without it, third-party scripts have unrestricted access.
findings.evidence: [Page: dashboard] Header "permissions-policy" absent from HTTP response of https://integrity-dashboard-bf73ab673f4c.herokuapp.com/login

findings.title: [DASHBOARD] Missing security header: Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy (COOP)
findings.detail: COOP isolates the browsing context, preventing cross-origin pages opened in popups from accessing the window object of this page.
findings.evidence: [Page: dashboard] Header "cross-origin-opener-policy" absent from HTTP response of https://integrity-dashboard-bf73ab673f4c.herokuapp.com/login

findings.title: [DASHBOARD] Pillar 9: No GTM or GA4 Analytics snippet detected on guest page
findings.detail: Analytics containers (Google Tag Manager or GA4) were not detected in the DOM. Without analytics snippets, conversion tracking and visitor behavior metrics cannot be measured.
findings.evidence: [Page: dashboard] GTM ID: None | GA4 ID: None
findings.recommendation: Deploy Google Tag Manager (GTM) or GA4 measurement tag to track storefront conversions.

findings.title: Some Stores Listing column headings are cut off
findings.detail: A few column titles are shortened with "..." so users cannot read what the column is.
findings.evidence: Cut off: NO., PLAN, TOTAL TREES, CONTRIBUTION, SPENDING LIMIT, INSTALLED, UNINSTALLED, STATUS, ACTIONS
findings.recommendation: Widen the columns or allow headings to wrap.

findings.title: Some Dashboard table headings are cut off
findings.detail: Column titles such as "Contribution", "Transaction ID" and "Status" are shortened with "..." so users cannot read them.
findings.evidence: Cut off: NO., RANK, CONTRIBUTION AMOUNT, NO., TRANSACTION ID, CONTRIBUTION TYPE, TREES, AMOUNT (CAD), STATUS
findings.recommendation: Widen the columns or let headings wrap.

findings.title: Stores Listing row numbers restart on every page
findings.detail: On page 2 the "NO." column starts again at 1 instead of continuing from 6, so two different stores can both be "No. 1".
findings.recommendation: Number rows continuously across pages: (page − 1) × page size + row.

findings.title: The date filter on Stores cannot be closed with the keyboard
findings.detail: After opening the date calendar, pressing Escape leaves it open. Clicking outside it does close it, so only keyboard users are affected: they have no way to dismiss the calendar.
findings.recommendation: Close the calendar on the Escape key as well as on an outside click.

findings.title: The "View" button on Stores Listing is cut off on some screen widths (1024, 1280, 1440px)
findings.detail: On a 1024 / 1280 / 1440px-wide screen the Actions column runs off the right side of the table, so the "View" button is clipped or needs sideways scrolling. This is the only way to open a store's details.
findings.evidence: 390px: needs sideways scroll, 9 cut heading(s) | 768px: needs sideways scroll, 9 cut heading(s) | 1024px: needs sideways scroll, 9 cut heading(s) | 1280px: needs sideways scroll, 9 cut heading(s) | 1440px: needs sideways scroll, 9 cut heading(s) | 1920px: ok, 3 cut heading(s)
findings.recommendation: Let the table fit its container: reduce column padding, allow headings and the Spending Limit to wrap, or give the Actions column a fixed minimum width.

findings.title: The date filter on Store Detail cannot be closed with the keyboard
findings.detail: After opening the date calendar, pressing Escape leaves it open. Clicking outside it does close it, so only keyboard users are affected: they have no way to dismiss the calendar.
findings.recommendation: Close the calendar on the Escape key as well as on an outside click.

findings.title: Install History lists the same event twice
findings.detail: The same install/uninstall event is recorded twice within the same minute: Integrity Reforestation: Uninstalled on 10/5/2026 08:03 PM; chillymoose.ca: Uninstalled on 10/2/2026 09:02 PM; app-review-4c002598-r119306-a0-primary: Uninstalled on 9/26/2026 09:37 PM. This usually means the app received the same Shopify notification twice, and it inflates the uninstall count.
findings.evidence: Integrity Reforestation: Uninstalled on 10/5/2026 08:03 PM | chillymoose.ca: Uninstalled on 10/2/2026 09:02 PM | app-review-4c002598-r119306-a0-primary: Uninstalled on 9/26/2026 09:37 PM
findings.recommendation: Ignore a repeated install/uninstall notification for the same store and timestamp.
